research_rationale: The complete held EO12720 original establishes the Council and ancillary advisory, information, support, expense and FACA functions. Its original §3(e) two-year term was replaced by EO12783 with an express January 16, 1993 termination. The immediate replacement directive contains no delayed effective clause; December 17, 1991 is inferred from its operative direction and execution, not blindly copied from metadata. Original §3(e) ends on replacement, while remaining Council-dependent commands cease January 16, 1993. EO12869 §§4(c),6 formally revoke September 30, 1993 and do not supply the first end. No independent policy direction survives the Council; accrued statutory travel claims do not continue its executive functions. The OFR disposition/corpus search covers this post-1937 order and locates the extension and revocation; no conflicts or missing actor provisions are listed. This is a bounded search judgment on this provisional dossier, not a present-law or readiness finding. Frozen full-run re-confirmation: Full-run audit preserves EO12783 extension and EO12869 revocation as the only named actor events. EO12783 provision boundaries now omit page furniture/signature but retain the complete immediate replacement directive and January 16, 1993 terminal date. Original §3(e) replacement on December 17, 1991, preceding the original July 16, 1992 sunset, prevents that earlier sunset; other dependent commands end January 16, 1993. Original funding-availability conditions do not establish any earlier event. The original and full actor-context text bytes and hashes are identical to those substantively read before freeze. The original metadata grade now reads original_representation_unverified, with requires_page_check false; no page-image inspection is asserted. Added alternative actor records are duplicate exact-text or normalized transcriptions of these same provisions, without a competing legal direction. EO12869 §6 expressly establishes September 30, 1993 effectiveness; this later formal revocation is not the first ending. Corrected inventory spans were reconstructed against the new original evidence and remain exact, exhaustive and disjoint. Accrued statutory travel reimbursement may survive, but no independent continuing executive function or transfer is found. No conflicts, missing provisions or current-law leads are present; the same post-1937 bounded OFR search remains accepted, without treating USC release coverage through October 9 as current law through October 14. This reconfirms producer approval for review against the frozen dossier and makes no readiness/status/independent-review assertion.
